roi.detectionConfigurationDescription: Set the specific parameters for each detection type to fine-tune alert triggers.
roi.queueCountThresholdDescription: Set the minimum number of people required to trigger a queue congestion alert. (e.g., 3)
roi.queueDwellTimeSecondsDescription: Define how long people must remain in the queue to trigger an alert. (e.g., 30 seconds
roi.confidenceThresholdDescription: Minimum confidence level required to trigger a suspicious loitering alert. Higher values reduce false alerts but may miss subtle loitering behavior.
roi.dwellTimeSecondsDescription: Specify the duration a vehicle must remain stationary to trigger a dwell time alert. (e.g., 15 seconds)
roi.attendantAbsenceDwellTimeDescription: Set the maximum time an attendant can be absent from the pump area before an alert is triggered. (e.g., 6 seconds)
roi.cellphoneDwellTimeDescription: The minimum time a person must hold/use a phone before detection.
roi.suspiciousLoiteringDescription: The number of seconds someone must remain in the area to be considered loitering.
roi.crowdSurgeQueueCountThresholdDescription: Set the minimum number of people required to trigger a crowd surge alert. (e.g., 10)
roi.crowdSurgeDwellTimeSecondsDescription: Define how long the crowd must remain to trigger a stampede risk alert. (e.g., 30 seconds)
roi.ppeDwellTimeSecondsDescription: The minimum time a person must be without proper PPE (helmet, vest) to trigger a violation alert. (e.g., 5 seconds)
roi.fireSmokeDwellTimeSecondsDescription: The duration required to confirm fire or smoke presence before triggering an alert. (e.g., 1 second)
